Specification of State Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
Please note that a change in a
NmNetworkHandle
can cause state transitions to more
than one
StateMachine
.
NmNetworkHandle
could be seen as a kind of "remote
control", and for this reason a change in a
NmNetworkHandle
could activate function-
ality in more than one
StateMachine
. E.g. switching on parking assistance could
activate the rear camera and proximity sensor, which could be controlled by different
StateMachines
.
